title: Chapter 448 Pterosaur Maris
content:
Chapter 448 Pterosaur Maris

"Thank you for your kindness, Your Majesty the Demon King. I am still too young and my strength is too limited to take on such a heavy responsibility."

"Hmph, if you don't accept my toast, then you should drink the wine."

Mikhail on the side couldn't hold it back any longer.

"In that case, there is no point in saying more."

The Demon King waved his hand, and the monsters rushed to the Great Wall again.

The corpses of the monsters from the last battle had not been cleaned up yet.

At this time, the smell of rotting corpses was everywhere.

But this had no effect on the monsters.

The human soldiers on the wall were a little uncomfortable at first.

After a while, they gradually adapted and began to resist in an orderly manner.

These recruits are basically reserve forces.

The combat power is not strong.

Wang Shuo had to let the intermediate warriors resist in the front.

In this way, most of the monsters could not even get close to the wall and were killed.

Maris no longer hesitated and rushed towards Wang Shuo quickly.

He thought, to catch the thief first, catch the king.

If Wang Shuo is taken down, the battle might be over.

But Wang Shuo was prepared.

Even facing the strongest king, Wang Shuo is not without any resistance.

Seeing Wang Shuo being attacked, the remaining nine high-level warriors quickly moved together.

They had set a strategy before.

They must force the Demon King to take action, and then gather all the high-level warriors to besiege the Demon King together.

As long as the Demon King is taken down, the battle will be over.

As for where they got the confidence, of course there is the precedent of Gong Zheng fighting against the strongest king. Others only need to support and then find the right opportunity to attack.

Gong Zheng quickly grew bigger, and his current size has reached 10 meters.

It is a living stone statue, but it still retains the flexibility of a human.

Maris attacked tentatively, but did not cause any damage to the stone man.

He was a little angry and wanted to increase the intensity of the attack.

But it was still easily resisted.

This made Naris doubt whether he was a fake strongest king.

He wanted to turn around and attack others, but Gong Zheng's huge body gave his teammates good protection.

At the same time, he also had a taunting skill, which made Naris very uncomfortable.

Wang Shuo did not choose to attack the demon king directly, but slaughtered ordinary demon beasts on the side.

Seeing Mikhail also joined the battlefield.

Wang Shuo released the Ice Phoenix to hold Mikhail.

On the other side, Ye Tianba, Good, Zhao Bangde, Zhu Dongheng and others advanced and retreated in a reasonable manner, attacking and defending at the same time.

Together, they fought tacitly countless times and cooperated very well.

No matter how Maris changed his moves, he couldn't kill anyone.

This made him a little angry.

Maris immediately transformed into his original form.

A pterosaur with a wingspan of more than 50 meters appeared in front of everyone.

There are advantages and disadvantages to transforming demon beasts and showing their original forms.

The disadvantage is that it is not conducive to the use of weapons, and the body is huge and easy to be hit by the opponent.

The advantage is also obvious, that is, it can enhance strength.

"Roar."

Naris roared wildly, and the sound shook the whole field.

The monsters around were all knocked down by the huge sound waves.

But the impact of this sound wave was not an attack on Zhao Bangde and others.

After Maris turned into his original form, his combat power increased by at least twice.

With a flap of his two wings, he could blow up a huge wind and sand.

But these means were just for show and could not cause any harm to high-level warriors.

Gong Zheng knew in his heart that this pterosaur must be extraordinary. He held his breath and waited for Maris to attack in the sky.
